scope: 42 new paired observations; A/B randomized independently per query; only blind-review-third-input.json read for response evidence
limitations: Provisional intent judgements, not human or production quality acceptance.
No identities, mappings, unblinded files, logs, metrics or other response evidence inspected.
No ranked-result outcomes, raw probabilities, complete attribute definitions or downstream concrete routing were supplied.
Soft weights/attributes are not assumed to impose hard eligibility.
Related traits and obvious implications were permitted; response length and label count were not scored.
